device.description: 16-bit voltage-output DAC (+-10 V, +-5 V or 0 to +10 V, internal +10 V reference) with double-buffered synchronous serial interface, SDO for cascading and asynchronous clear (Burr-Brown)
device.note: dac714.pdf (SBAS032A) p.2 pin configuration and pin descriptions, p.3 specifications (binary two's complement input, TTL logic levels, +VCC/-VCC 11.4-16.5 V), p.4 timing specifications, truth table and timing diagrams, p.6 interface logic (double-buffered level-triggered latches; CLR resets both latches to 0000H = mid-scale), p.8 Table I input codes, p.9 serial interface (A0 input register enable, A1 D/A latch enable, SDO cascading)

registers.name: INPUT
registers.note: input (shift) register: loaded MSB first while A0 is low; its MSB end is SDO (p.4, p.9); reset value not stated, CLR sets it to 0000H (p.6)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: D/A latch (binary two's complement, 0000H = mid-scale, Table I): loaded from INPUT while A1 is low (CLK strobe, truth table p.4); CLR sets 0000H

commands.name: SHIFT
commands.note: A0 low: SDI shifted in MSB first on CLK rising edges; the input register holds the last 16 bits when A0 returns high (p.4 truth table, p.9 cascading)

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3 (specifications, supplies, input code), p.4 (timing, truth table, timing diagrams), p.6 (interface logic, CLR), p.8 (Table I codes), p.9 (serial interface)
notModeled: analog output, +10 V reference, range resistors RFB2/RBPO, gain/offset adjust (VOUT, VREF OUT never driven)

the D/A latch loads while A1 is low during a CLK pulse (truth table p.4); modeled as LDAC level mode on A1 without the CLK strobe; A0 = A1 = 0 two-wire operation follows only at the end of each 16-bit frame

SDO is the shift register's serial output at all times; modeled only while A0 is low, as the previous input-register contents followed by zeros (the 16-bit delayed SDI copy used for cascading beyond 16 clocks is not modeled)
the input register shifts on every CLK while A0 is low; the model writes it once, from the last 16 bits, when A0 rises

power-on contents of the latches are not stated in the datasheet (reset 0 = 0000H mid-scale assumed); CLR (active low, 200 ns min) sets both latches to 0000H; clearCode 0 is that code (two's complement mid-scale)

digital inputs are TTL (1.4 V threshold, VIH max VCC - 1.4 V) driven from 5 V logic and SDO swings 0.4-2.4/5 V; there is no logic supply pin, so vcc is the +VCC supply range; -VCC (-11.4 to -16.5 V) is in analog
setup/hold times, 10 MHz max clock (tCLK 100 ns)
variants: DAC714P/U/HB/HC/HL grades in the same datasheet differ only in linearity and temperature range; the skeleton parts are DAC714U and DAC714U/1K (SOIC). DAC716 (dac716.pdf) is the same interface with straight-binary 0 to +10 V output.
